europe_now.title: Zelenskyy Urges New Sanctions and Openness to Meeting Putin
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has called on the United States to implement immediate new sanctions against Russia following a series of deadly strikes. Additionally, he stated in an interview that he would be open to a potential meeting with Vladimir Putin at an upcoming international summit.

sources.headline: In an exclusive interview with DW, Zelenskyy says he would be open to meeting with Putin at the G20 summit in Miami
Zelensky urges Trump to impose new Russia sanctions 'now', after deadly Ukraine strikes

europe_now.title: Sweden Election and NATO Security Debates
europe_now.summary: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has warned that the country's ongoing NATO missions could face significant risks if the left wins the upcoming election. Meanwhile, European Union institutions have opted to delay a major tobacco tax vote until the Swedish electoral process concludes.

sources.headline: EU delays key tobacco tax vote until after Swedish election
Sweden’s NATO missions are at risk if the left wins election, warns PM Kristersson

top_stories.title: Royal Bereavement in Norway
top_stories.summary: Norway's Princess Astrid has passed away just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, King Harald. The royal family confirmed the news following her recent attendance at the state mourning events.

sources.headline: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral

top_stories.title: European Space Deal Backlash
top_stories.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has faced accusations of an abuse of power after backing a controversial space mega deal. Critics have raised governance concerns regarding the handling of Project Bromo.

sources.headline: ‘Abuse of power’: Von der Leyen rapped after backing space mega deal
